mode: Window-free egui and lint checks only; no native-window, desktop, file-dialog or rendered-preview launches.

focused_gui.scope: Classic and Studio, each at scale 1/light and scale 2/dark with repeated layout. Escape restores a real layer-name field without publishing, changing ticket/document semantics or cancelling unpublished canvas text. A later separate Escape cancels the canvas preview without publication. An ordinary Enter rename then publishes exactly once.

regression_baseline.scope: The unchanged cancellation prefix of the added regression; the baseline stops at its first failure before later acceptance checks.
regression_baseline.result: Before the fix, Escape renamed Layer 2 to Discard this rename instead of discarding the draft. The expected baseline failure is archived separately from current passing logs.

scope: Layer-name fields use stable document/layer-scoped IDs, capture Escape while focused, restore the current committed name and release focus before the focus-loss commit path. Enter and normal focus-loss behavior retain host action routing and layer ownership.
limits: Normal focused-field Escape is tested, not arbitrary native event coalescing or IME. Accepting a rename retains the existing command policy that resolves pending canvas text; the test separately cancels that preview before checking one ordinary rename publication. Retained editable text objects and native/rendered parity remain separate work.
